# Slash commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-commands-doc.mjs from src/commands/*.cmd.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:commands`. -->

60 commands. Free text typed without a leading `/` goes to `/assistant`.
An **async** command starts a crew and returns a ticket; its result is printed when the crew completes.

| Command | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/advisor` | async | Show, set or disable the advisor model, or run a second opinion on the last answer. |
| `/agents` | sync | List, create, edit or delete saved agent configurations (.orkeon/agents.json). |
| `/analyze` | async | Analyze the codebase deterministically (index → maps → dependency graph) and synthesize business objects + dependencies; --raw prints the harvest without any LLM call. |
| `/assistant` | async | Ask the interactive coding agent to work on a request. |
| `/branch` | sync | Show the current git branch, or check out the given one (refuses on a dirty tree). |
| `/btw` | sync | Inject a side note into the session context ("by the way…"). |
| `/bughunter` | async | Hunt for bugs in the staged changes (code review, correctness lens only). |
| `/clear` | sync | Clear the conversation buffer and the screen. |
| `/commit` | async | Draft and create a conventional commit for the current changes (confirms first; --yes skips). |
| `/compact` | async | Compact the session conversation buffer to free up context. |
| `/config` | sync | List, get, set or unset settings over the declared key space (file + session layers). |
| `/context` | sync | Show the current session context: title, model, messages, tokens, pressure. |
| `/copy` | sync | Re-print the last assistant output in full (terminal copy; no OS clipboard). |
| `/cost` | sync | Show cumulative session cost in USD and token usage. |
| `/ctx-viz` | sync | Visualise the context window: tokens used, remaining, and percent full. |
| `/debug-tool-call` | sync | Invoke a registered tool with JSON arguments and print its raw result. |
| `/diff` | sync | Show the working-tree diff, or the staged diff with --staged. |
| `/doctor` | sync | Health check: toolchain, LLM configuration, tool catalogue and VFS mounts. |
| `/effort` | sync | Show or set the session reasoning-effort level (low\|medium\|high). |
| `/env` | sync | Show environment information: OS, kernel, and node version. |
| `/exit` | sync | Exit the coding-agent REPL. |
| `/export` | sync | Export the session (conversation + memory + cost) to a markdown file. |
| `/extra-usage` | sync | Show the extended usage breakdown: window, telemetry, cost, cache. |
| `/fast` | sync | Toggle fast mode (drop the advisory prompt blocks for latency). |
| `/feedback` | sync | Record feedback for the agent (stored as a durable 'feedback' memory). |
| `/files` | sync | List the files in a directory (defaults to /workspace). |
| `/force-snip` | sync | Immediately truncate the conversation to the head plus the last N exchanges. |
| `/hooks` | sync | List, add or remove declarative hooks (pre-tool\|post-tool\|stop). |
| `/init-verifiers` | async | Detect test tooling and author verification skills for uncovered zones. |
| `/init` | async | Analyse the workspace and generate a CLAUDE.md. |
| `/memory` | sync | List, add, delete, or get typed memory entries (user/project/feedback/reference). |
| `/mode` | sync | Cycle, show or set the session-default permission mode of the assistant. |
| `/model` | sync | Show the effective model for the next turn, or switch it without relaunching. |
| `/onboarding` | sync | Show the first-run orientation guide. |
| `/output-style` | sync | Show or set the session's answer style (consumed by the assistant's prompt). |
| `/passes` | sync | Show or set the session reasoning-pass count (1-5). |
| `/permissions` | sync | Show the permission surface; add, remove, list or clear the session's tool rules. |
| `/plan` | sync | Toggle plan mode (read-only session default). |
| `/proactive` | sync | Toggle proactive follow-up suggestions from the assistant. |
| `/release-notes` | sync | Show the release notes for this build. |
| `/rename` | sync | Set the current session's title. |
| `/reset-session` | sync | Clear the current session conversation buffer. |
| `/resume` | sync | Resume the current in-memory session (shows the recent turns). |
| `/review` | async | Run a multi-facet code review on staged changes. |
| `/rewind` | sync | Rewind the session by one exchange (drops the last user turn and what followed). |
| `/sandbox-toggle` | sync | Record the sandbox preference (no-op: the container IS the sandbox). |
| `/say` | async | Read a text aloud, or the assistant's last answer with no text (speech MCP server); --stop cuts the reading. |
| `/security-review` | async | Review the staged changes for security issues (security lens only). |
| `/session` | sync | Show the current session's metadata (title, model, message count). |
| `/skills` | sync | List, attach or detach skill files (workspace markdown playbooks). |
| `/stats` | sync | Show full session telemetry: message count, tokens, cost, calls. |
| `/status` | sync | Show the session status: model, workspace, context, cost and crews. |
| `/summary` | async | Generate an LLM summary of the session (read-only; does not rewrite the buffer). |
| `/tag` | sync | Tag a note into typed memory for later recall. |
| `/tasks` | sync | Manage the session task list: add, list, done, clear. |
| `/transcribe` | async | Transcribe an audio or video file under /audio (Whisper MCP server); --then runs an instruction on the transcription, --list shows the files. |
| `/upgrade` | sync | Show the current version and how the runtime is pinned (no self-update channel). |
| `/usage` | sync | Show token usage against the context window (pressure tier + autocompact trigger). |
| `/version` | sync | Show the Orkeon coding-agent CLI version. |
| `/voice` | async | Dictate a request: record the microphone until a silence and show the text; /voice send sends it, --go sends at once. |
